notes.title: WE'RE BACK
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36084130/667acf11a134645475ceb6f2b92401a9358f768e.png[/img]
If you are curious to know more about our project come and visit us on Kickstarter, our campaign is finally online and will be available throughout April! Don't miss our four feline events, each with a special offer/novelty to catch on the fly.
We hope you'll like it and support us in this kick off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36084130/a960807a1cf501916eb3fa748a0c8265a6a4a49b.png[/img]
If you prefer to take action, don't waste any more time reading more and download our free demo. It represents only 5% of the complete game but at the same time it is the perfect prologue to our story. Immerse yourself in a soft feline world and evaluate our project in person. We look forward to hear your opinion about this prologue to our history. 
Enjoy

notes.title: COME BACK! Stronger and softer
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Our campaign has come to an end and we have failed it. However, this is not the end of our road but only the beginning. This experience has given me the opportunity to understand many mistakes that I have made and in doing so that I can better prepare for the future. I really thank all the supporters who supported me by saying that this project deserved a second chance! You have encouraged me to do better and for that reason I am very grateful to you! Thank you all! 

We'll be back! Stronger, softer and more organized. I'm going to repeat the Kickstarter campaign in early 2020, after the holidays have passed. 

We'll be back to you with many new features including the full demo available on steam! 

After a short break to get the ideas in order, my team will return to work hard to make our Kickstarter campaign even better. 

We will try to be more present on social media in these months of waiting to be able to update you almost daily of the progress that is taking place within the development team. 

That's a promise!Taro won't die today but on the contrary will come back even better than before!! 

COME BACK!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36084130/8b04a7dd2eedd9dbf1c30cf3f68842231ba900c9.jpg[/img]
